summary: Iter 54 — People-Picker + CAPA Register tested end-to-end on trades.demo & hospitality.demo. 19/19 backend pytest cases pass (picker shape, ranking, me-pin, include_me toggle, limit, source_type=user/worker; CAPA CRUD, summary, multi-tenant isolation, legacy-string assignee normalisation, picker-object assignee persist, status filters, linked-entity filters, soft-archive, close idempotency, risk-review accept-remediation auto-spawns CAPA with source=risk_review_remediation + linked_entity_type=review, empty-body 400). Frontend smoke: /dashboard/capa loads with capa-page/capa-stats/capa-table/capa-create-btn; Create modal contains capa-create-assignee; PeoplePicker popover opens, search input filters, ME + WORKER badges render correctly; CAPA submit creates a row that appears in the table immediately. /dashboard/risk-register/new mounts picker-risk-owner (PeoplePicker) replacing old Select, search by 'demo' filters to Me row.
action_items: Consider adding data-testid='picker-option-<id>' to each PeoplePicker option row (currently option rows in the popover are clickable but have no per-row test id). Minor — testing agents can still locate via role/text but a stable testid would harden automation.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/people_picker.py: dedupe-by-email loop is O(N*M) when there are many users + many workers; fine at MVP scale but consider building an index dict if seed grows >5k.
routes/capa.py: legacy-fallback branches (query without account_id) double the DB roundtrips on every read; consider single $or query.

routes/capa.py update_capa: invalid status now correctly 400s, but invalid action_type/priority on UPDATE returns 400 only for action_type — priority is silently accepted; consider validating priority on PATCH for consistency with POST.
routes/capa.py archive uses status='archived' which is in STATUSES set but no endpoint exposes 'unarchive'. Confirm intended UX.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_* CAPA rows + 1 TEST_PickerWorker worker created in trades.demo tenant via tests. Safe to leave (filtered by TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PeoplePicker uses Popover; option rows currently lack data-testid='picker-option-*'. Picker for risk_owner uses data-testid='picker-risk-owner'; CAPA assignee uses 'capa-create-assignee'. Clear button testid format: 'picker-clear-<field>' (e.g. picker-clear-risk-owner) — unverified because options have no testid. accept-remediation lives at POST /api/risk-reviews/{review_id}/accept-remediation and accepts {capa_items:[{description, action_type, assigned_to, due_date, priority}]} — returns {capa_ids: [...]}.
